title: Reverse Roll Heavy Winching Tutorial with Tom Luciano
summary: Current news and information related to Miller Industries products and services.
body_markdown:
In this video, Tom Luciano of Miller Industries demonstrates how to do a heavy winching reverse roll recovery technique. This tutorial goes through the proper setup needed, which situation(s) you’ll need to understand this maneuver for, and the reasoning behind why you should consider this lift for future recoveries.


If you’d like to learn more about the[Century 1150](https://www.millerind.com/products/century/century-1150-1150r-1150rxp) , or check out more videos like this one, feel free to look on our Miller Industries website, or our[Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/millerind) and[Youtube!](https://www.youtube.com/c/MillerIndustriesTowingEquipmentInc/videos)
